messages:
Priya: Quick 90-day pattern triage. Found 4 recurring themes: downstream rate-limit spikes, autoscaler drift, overlapping canary rollouts, and cache eviction storms. Need owners + small remediation tasks.

Jorge: Sounds good. Can we pick owners now?

Priya: Proposed: Jorge -> rate-limits, Nora -> autoscaler, Ben -> rollouts, Priya -> cache. ETAs two weeks for minimal fixes.

Nora: I'll add a CI lint job + nightly config diff. Target PR by 2026-05-28.

Ben: For rollouts I'll add a preflight check to prevent overlap and a playbook snippet. ETA 2026-05-29.

Jorge: I'll implement a per-host leaky bucket + alert and measure. ETA 2026-06-03. Need infra tester.

Priya: I'll prototype TTL jitter for cache and run perf tests. ETA 2026-05-25.

PagerBot: INC-FOLLOWUP-2026-1212 created and assigned -> Priya, due 2026-06-03.

Ben: Suggest adding "regression?" column to the tracker and estimated monthly cost avoided. Helps prioritization.

Priya: Agreed. I'll push tracker CSV and tag related postmortems. Scheduling a 30m monthly sync starting 2026-05-20 16:00 PT.

Nora: Ack. I'll update tracker when PR lands.

Jorge: Ack - opening INF ticket for test env and will cc Ben.

Priya: Closing: owners update tracker/tickets by ETAs. If blocked, post ticket IDs here.

All: ack
